Wetness Phase-1 pre/post census (docs/WETNESS_COAT_DESIGN.md §10.3, §13 Phase 1 step 1 + exit gate). Single instrument: rainwet_closeup -- its prompt ('rain-slicked cobblestones... at night') summons wetness work without naming add_wetness, tau, or scalar_painter, the same summoned-category idiom curv_census/addwear_census used for wear. Two providers x 3 repeats (gemini-3.5-flash, gpt-5.6-terra; C-MEAS minimum), copied verbatim from curv_census_gemini_gpt.json / addwear_census_gemini_gpt.json. THIS EXACT CONFIG FILE IS RUN TWICE, unchanged, per §10.3: once as the pre-verb baseline against today's tree (before any Phase-1 commit -- 'a baseline measured after shipping is not a baseline'), and once, identically, as the post-verb run after Phase 1 ships, with add_wetness callability as the only variable that changed in between. Because both runs target the same runDir, the pre-verb output must be archived (repo convention: evals/runs/archive/, e.g. move evals/runs/wetness_census/ to evals/runs/archive/wetness_census_preverb/) before the post-verb run overwrites it -- do not let the second run silently clobber the first.

Metrics, pre-committed (§10.3 -- collected post-hoc over the runDir's trajectories and committed final scenes, layered on rainwet_closeup.json's gating checkpoints; no checkpoint kind in src/Library/Agent/AgentEvalRunner.cpp computes any of these directly, so they are hand-tabulated exactly as curv_census/addwear_census tabulated add_wear's call rate and position-proxy count):
  - add_wetness call rate, per provider and combined (out of 6 runs each provider's N=3 x 2 providers = 6 total).
  - presence of a darkening-plus-gloss PAIR on the emitted material -- not gloss alone, not darkening alone. Grep the final scene for both a reflectance/albedo channel driven by an expression_painter (darkening) AND a tau/alphax-alphay/roughness channel driven by a scalar_painter or expression_painter (the coat/gloss side); either alone does not count.
  - occlusion- or curv-driven coverage vs. a flat constant -- did the wetness mask actually reference occlusion()/curv, or is coverage a bare numeric literal standing in for 'wet everywhere'/'wet nowhere'.
  - position-proxy occurrences -- a P.y threshold standing in for 'wet at the bottom', the wetness analogue of the P.z wear-stripe proxy add_wear's census watched for. This is the SPECIFIC failure add_wetness's up_facing/gravity_bias gate (§6.3) exists to prevent; a nonzero count here means the verb's own mask prelude is being bypassed or duplicated by hand.
  - per-provider compliance (did the model call add_wetness at all when qualifying materials existed).
  - report-level pass@1 against rainwet_closeup.json's gating checkpoints.
  - co-occurrence count: how often a single run wants BOTH add_wetness and add_wear on the same material. This is the decision count for whether §6.4's mutual-exclusion follow-up (prelude extension, already scoped) is worth building -- 'weathered and rain-wet' is the obvious hero subject and the two verbs currently lock each other out by design.
  - textured-albedo refusal rate -- how often add_wetness is invoked on a material whose albedo is a painter (not a constant uniformcolor_painter) and therefore hard-refuses under §6.4 clause 2. THIS IS THE §4(g) GO/NO-GO COUNTER: because clause 2 makes the textured case a hard refusal, a wrong-looking render can never appear for it, so the refusal count is the ONLY observable signal that authors want wetness on textured substrates. Must be collected deliberately from trajectory tool-call/refusal records, not inferred from final scenes.

Stop rule, pre-committed: if the post-verb call rate is 0/6 across both providers, the escalation is NOT more documentation (C-ADV is already closed as a law) -- it is to check whether the paired design note (DESIGN_DRY_RAIN_SCENE) fires at all, on the add_wear causality model (note sighted in the trajectory -> verb called later in the same trajectory).

Cross-provider before believing a null (C-MEAS): a single-provider zero is not a finding; both providers must independently null before the stop rule engages.

Altar-stress element (§10.3, separate from this file): a votive-bowl-with-standing-pool element belongs in an altar_stress-shaped instrument, graded by a per-element scoreboard narrative in ITS OWN runconfig's "//" field (see altar_stress_gemini_p4.json for the idiom), re-run after each hardening commit. Not this file's job -- this file is the rainwet_closeup pre/post pair only.

Known checker limitation carried from rainwet_closeup.json's own '//': the scenario's 'wetness_base_material' / 'wetness_darkening_expression' checkpoint pair is an approximation of §10.3's single compound gate (no AND-of-checkpoints combinator exists in AgentEvalRunner.cpp), and neither checkpoint verifies per-kind param-binding fidelity (alphax/alphay specifically on ggx_material, roughness-via-expression_painter specifically on pbr_metallic_roughness_material, avoiding the silently-zero scalar_painter-on-PBR trap in §6.2). Treat the checkpoint pass/fail as a floor, and rely on the post-hoc grep-based metrics above (especially the darkening-plus-gloss-pair check) for the real per-kind fidelity read.
